title: Tino Sage extends a powerful appeal for unity in “Hold My Hand”
htmlContent:
Tino Sage offers a gentle yet powerful message of togetherness, love, and the need to connect. Her new single, "Hold My Hand," is a heartfelt message told through the innocent and urgent voices of children. The song was recorded in a friend's cozy basement in Toronto, giving it an authentic feel that many mainstream songs lack.

Sage's voice is warm and convincing, wrapping around listeners like a comforting hug while encouraging them to realize their responsibilities. "Hold My Hand" offers a straightforward and important request to do better for future generations.

https://open.spotify.com/album/6wvYDc0LGFSsAaM5IWIBm5?si=ER-WoglpSJCQOkuIlVv6Jg

It softly reminds us of the significance of our choices and the kind of world we're creating. Sage encourages us to listen to the young voices calling for a brighter future. In a time when music can either separate us or bring us together, "Hold My Hand" chooses to unite.
